timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: NEUTRAL timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,520 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently fluctuating below 1,520 KRW/USD, with geopolitical tensions pushing it weaker but authorities monitoring to prevent further depreciation. However, Hana Securities forecasts the won will gradually strengthen (lower KRW/USD) as external headwinds pass their peak, suggesting the rate may improve soon.

TIP: Since a stronger won is expected ahead, consider waiting a few weeks if possible, but maintain your monthly conversion discipline regardless—timing the exact bottom is difficult, and consistency matters more than perfection for fixed obligations.
